name: Hiro
source: A half-Japanese transfer student attending a unique westernised international school for his final year. Listless and apathetic towards his studies, he drifts through his days without purpose until a chance encounter over a lost library card leads him to [url=/c59647]Ceridwen Erwood[/url], changing the course of both their lives.
